lines.t: Gears of War is back after seven years, and it goes back to the very first day of the war.
It's a third person cover shooter. You duck behind walls, fight monsters called the Locust, and yes, your rifle has a chainsaw.
E-Day is a prequel, set 14 years before the first game, on the day the monsters burst out of the ground.
You play as a young Marcus Fenix, with his best friend Dom at his side.
The full launch is October 6th on Xbox and PC, and it's on Game Pass from day one.
The hype is real. It even took over WWE SummerSlam.
In early access it peaked at over 20,000 players on Steam. That's double Gears 5.
Reviews are strong too, with scores in the high eighties.
Fun fact: the famous chainsaw gun started out as a sketch of a buzzsaw.

lines.t: The first game cost about 10 million dollars to make, and sold 3 million copies in ten weeks.
And its 2006 TV ad sent the song Mad World to number one on iTunes.
The whole series has sold over 41 million copies.
